normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents… "Casablanca," your slice of paradise in the exclusive Waters Edge community of Seacrest Beach directly adjacent to Rosemary Beach. Just 50 feet from the sand, this stunning retreat features a private pool, 3 primary suites, Gulf-view balconies, and vibrant outdoor spaces. Cruise scenic paths on 7 provided bikes to explore 30A. Designed for memorable group vacations, Casablanca is your perfect escape. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS *** 50 Feet to Beach Access: Just steps from the private community beach entrance. Seasonal Beach Service Included: Comes with 2 chairs and 1 umbrella for a seamless beach day. Private Pool: A serene, seasonally heated oasis, perfect for lounging and unwinding in style. Summer Kitchen: Enjoy grilling and dining under the warm Florida sun. Peek-a-Boo Gulf Views: Enjoy glimpses of the sparkling waters from the comfort of your retreat. Perfect for Multi-families & Groups: 5 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms, sleeps 12 comfortably, including 3 primary suites with king beds, luxurious en-suites, and private balconies Explore 30A with Bikes: Includes 7 cruiser bikes for adventures around Seacrest, Rosemary, and Alys Beach Prime Location: Waters Edge - a gated beachside community directly adjacent to Rosemary Beach, near shops, dining, and nightlifeEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests: "Amazing house and location! Just steps from the beach and close to downtown Rosemary Beach. Perfect getaway!" – Rafael D. "Great house, immaculate pool, and the perfect layout for two families. Would definitely recommend!" – David D. "This property had everything we needed for an incredible girls’ trip. The proximity to the beach and town made it hassle-free and truly delightful!" – Hannah M.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into the open-concept living room, designed with coastal-inspired decor, cozy seating, and natural lighting. Perfect for entertaining, it flows seamlessly into the dining area and kitchen while offering easy access to the outdoor pool deck. Coastal decor with comfortable seating and natural light Large smart TV for entertainment Sliding glass doors leading to the outdoor oasis*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Casablanca’s gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a spacious island with bar seating. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats 8, ideal for family meals or game nights. Fully equipped kitchen with modern appliances Granite countertops and oversized island with seating for 5 Dining table seats 8, perfect for group gatherings*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Your private backyard retreat features a seasonally heated pool, ample lounging space, an outdoor summer kitchen, and a 3rd-floor covered patio. Whether grilling poolside, soaking in the Florida sun, or enjoying the views from the patio, this space is perfect for relaxation and fun. Private seasonally heated pool with 4 luxury sun loungers Summer kitchen with grill, sink, and fridge for outdoor cooking Al fresco dining area seating 8 at the dining table and additional seating for 4 3rd-floor entertaining area with a wet bar and covered patio with outdoor dining for 4*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor: Queens Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen beds with poolside access and an en-suite bathroom with a tub/shower combo2nd Floor: Primary Suite 1: King-size bed, private Gulf-view balcony, luxurious en-suite with soaking tub and dual showerheads Bunk Room: Twin-over-Twin bunk, shares a bathroom with the adjacent primary suite Primary Suite 2: King-size bed, private pool-view balcony, en-suite with double vanity and soaking tub3rd Floor: Primary Suite 3: King-size bed, balcony with Gulf views, en-suite with shower/tub combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Casablanca is nestled in the prestigious Waters Edge community, right next to Rosemary Beach. Just steps away from boutique shops, acclaimed restaurants, and vibrant live music, it’s the ultimate getaway on 30A. With beach service included and located only 50 feet from the shoreline, Casablanca offers the perfect blend of luxury and relaxation for a carefree retreat. Rosemary Beach: 6-minute walk Alys Beach: 13-minute walk Peddler’s Pavilion: Seasonal live music and dining Beach Service is Included - 2 Chairs and 1 Umbrella Seasonally Quaint Coastal Community - Bike Friendly! The home is supplied With 7 Beach Cruiser Bikes to explore 30A*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes but can be added during checkout. We DO NOT accept wire transfers. Pools can only be heated between September 1st and April 30th. 7 adult bikes provided; waiver must be signed before receiving access codes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes. LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach. An active camera is on the left side of the front porch, overlooking the entrance. Beach Service is Included - 2 Chairs and 1 Umbrella Seasonally.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 15546STRO #: STR-015546
